evals.name: run-recipe-named-not-written-into
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features. The repository has a project skill at .claude/skills/run-clockwork/SKILL.md that starts the Clockwork web app, and no feature_map_dir is set anywhere.
evals.expected_output: The map goes to the default .claude/skills/feature-map/. Its index names run-clockwork as the launch recipe by name and does not copy the recipe's steps. No file is created or edited under .claude/skills/run-clockwork/.
expectations: Writes the map under .claude/skills/feature-map/
The index names run-clockwork as the launch recipe
Creates or edits no file under .claude/skills/run-clockwork/

evals.name: recorded-verify-skill-named
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features. The repository has no run-* skill, but /verify recorded .claude/skills/verify/SKILL.md at the repository root last week.
evals.expected_output: The index names .claude/skills/verify/SKILL.md as the launch recipe. The map is written to its own directory, never inside .claude/skills/verify/, and that file is left unchanged.
expectations: The index names .claude/skills/verify/SKILL.md as the launch recipe
Writes nothing inside .claude/skills/verify/

evals.name: no-recipe-offers-generator
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features. The repository has no .claude/skills/run-* skill and no .claude/skills/verify/SKILL.md. The README says the app starts with `npm run dev` on port 5173.
evals.expected_output: With no launch recipe, the person is offered /run-skill-generator to record one, as a command they type. Meanwhile the index records the start path /testing:run-e2e uses, here the documented `npm run dev` command.
expectations: Offers /run-skill-generator to the person rather than running it unasked
The index records `npm run dev` (the start path run-e2e uses) as the launch

evals.name: feature-file-slug
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features. Map only the feature the settings page calls `Billing / Export!`.
evals.expected_output: The feature file is billing-export.md: lower-cased, each run of characters outside a-z0-9 replaced by one hyphen, leading and trailing hyphens dropped. It has an H1, one sentence, and the four sections Parts, Entry points, Drive and Traps in that order.
expectations: Names the feature file billing-export.md
The file has exactly the four H2 sections Parts, Entry points, Drive and Traps, in that order

evals.name: unsafe-location-refused
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features. docs/conventions/testing.yaml sets `feature_map_dir: .claude/skills/run-shop/features`, and no overlay exists.
evals.expected_output: The location has a segment starting with run-, so it is refused: the report names docs/conventions/testing.yaml, feature_map_dir and the value. The run does not stop; the layer is dropped and the map goes to the default .claude/skills/feature-map/. Nothing is written under .claude/skills/run-shop/.
expectations: Names docs/conventions/testing.yaml, feature_map_dir and .claude/skills/run-shop/features as refused
Continues and writes the map to .claude/skills/feature-map/
Writes nothing under .claude/skills/run-shop/

evals.name: absolute-dotdot-verify-refused
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features --dir ../shared/map. The overlay .claude/testing.local.yaml sets `feature_map_dir: /srv/maps/shop` and docs/conventions/testing.yaml sets `feature_map_dir: tools/smoke-verify`.
evals.expected_output: Each source is refused in turn and named with its value and reason: --dir contains .., the overlay value is absolute, the team value ends in verify. None stops the run and none is written to; with no valid source the map goes to the default .claude/skills/feature-map/.
expectations: Refuses ../shared/map because it contains ..
Refuses /srv/maps/shop as an absolute path, naming .claude/testing.local.yaml
Refuses tools/smoke-verify because a segment ends in verify, naming docs/conventions/testing.yaml
Writes the map to .claude/skills/feature-map/

evals.name: done-only-after-one-feature-passes
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features. The app builds and starts; you have written the index and three feature files.
evals.expected_output: Before reporting done, the skill invokes /testing:run-e2e on one mapped feature, which runs the doctor and drives every entry point that feature lists. Done is reported only when that run passes; a failure caused by the map is fixed and re-run, and a failure against a healthy app leaves the map reported as written but unproven.
expectations: Invokes /testing:run-e2e on one mapped feature before reporting done
Does not report done while that run has not passed
Includes run-e2e's per-entry-point lines in the report

evals.name: chrome-map-attended-only
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features drive it with Claude in Chrome. The app needs the person's own single sign-on session.
evals.expected_output: The session instruction wins, so the recorded driver is chrome with the session as its source. The index marks the map attended-only (`Attended runs only.`), and says an unattended run stops with the gap report instead of switching drivers.
expectations: Records chrome as the driver, supplied by the session instruction
The index marks the map attended-only

evals.name: broken-checkout-gap-report
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features. `npm run build` fails on this checkout with a missing module error.
evals.expected_output: The checkout does not build, so the skill stops before writing any map file and emits a gap report naming the command, the tail of its output and what the person must fix.
expectations: Stops with a gap report naming the failing build command
Writes no map file

evals.name: long-slug-collision-stays-within-64
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features map these two features: 'Export every approved weekly timesheet for the finance team as a signed PDF archive' and 'Export every approved weekly timesheet for the finance team, as a signed PDF archive'.
evals.expected_output: Both titles give the same 83-character slug. The first file is cut to 64 characters: export-every-approved-weekly-timesheet-for-the-finance-team-as-a.md. The second needs the -2 suffix, so its slug is cut to 62 characters before the suffix is appended: export-every-approved-weekly-timesheet-for-the-finance-team-as-2.md. Neither name before .md is longer than 64 characters.
expectations: Names the first file export-every-approved-weekly-timesheet-for-the-finance-team-as-a.md
Names the second file export-every-approved-weekly-timesheet-for-the-finance-team-as-2.md
Writes no file whose name before .md is longer than 64 characters

evals.name: skills-root-refused
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features. docs/conventions/testing.yaml sets `feature_map_dir: ./.claude/skills/`, and no overlay exists.
evals.expected_output: The value is the skills root itself, so it is refused: the report names docs/conventions/testing.yaml, feature_map_dir and the value, and says the map must be its own directory under .claude/skills/, not the skills root. The run does not stop; the map goes to the default .claude/skills/feature-map/. No SKILL.md or feature file is written directly in .claude/skills/.
expectations: Names docs/conventions/testing.yaml, feature_map_dir and ./.claude/skills/ as refused
Writes the map under .claude/skills/feature-map/
Writes no file directly in .claude/skills/

evals.name: second-app-gets-its-own-dir
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features Clockwork admin. The repository builds apps/web (Clockwork web) and apps/admin (Clockwork admin). .claude/skills/feature-map/SKILL.md already exists and its index names Clockwork web, built from apps/web. No feature_map_dir is set.
evals.expected_output: The default directory already holds a map, and its index covers Clockwork web, a different app. The skill stops and writes nothing, names Clockwork web as the app that map covers, and gives the location for this app: --dir .claude/skills/feature-map-clockwork-admin. It does not send the person to /testing:refresh-feature-map for this app.
expectations: Writes nothing and leaves .claude/skills/feature-map/ unchanged
Names Clockwork web as the app the existing map covers
Gives --dir .claude/skills/feature-map-clockwork-admin for the admin app
Does not point at /testing:refresh-feature-map as the next step for the admin app

evals.name: harness-hosting-own-instance-doctor
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features. e2e_driver resolves to harness from docs/conventions/testing.yaml. The repository's end-to-end suite in tests/Ledger.E2E starts the app in-process itself and needs a Postgres container from compose.test.yaml; nothing is launched separately.
evals.expected_output: The index records harness as the driver and says the harness hosts its own instance. Its doctor checks what the harness needs: that tests/Ledger.E2E builds and that the Postgres service from compose.test.yaml answers. It does not probe a separately launched app URL.
expectations: The index says the harness hosts its own instance
The doctor checks the harness build and the Postgres service it depends on
The doctor does not probe a separately launched app instance

evals.name: harness-drive-line-stays-user-side
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features the invoice approval feature. The recorded driver is harness; the suite selects that feature's tests with `dotnet test tests/Ledger.E2E --filter Category=InvoiceApproval`. The code lives in InvoiceApprovalController and posts to /internal/approvals/commit.
evals.expected_output: The feature file's ## Drive section lists the user's steps (what the approver clicks and sees) and adds one line giving the harness command `dotnet test tests/Ledger.E2E --filter Category=InvoiceApproval`. InvoiceApprovalController and /internal/approvals/commit appear nowhere in the feature file.
expectations: ## Drive holds user-side steps
## Drive adds one line with the dotnet test filter command
The feature file does not mention InvoiceApprovalController or /internal/approvals/commit

evals.name: driver-unavailable-blocked
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features. The app builds and its doctor passes. The recorded driver is playwright, but when the proving run starts, /testing:run-e2e stops with a gap report: no Playwright browser is installed on this host.
evals.expected_output: The map is written but unproven, and the outcome is blocked: driver unavailable, reported with run-e2e's gap report. The skill does not edit the map after the failed run, does not switch the recorded driver to another one, and does not call the map done.
expectations: Reports the outcome as blocked: driver unavailable with run-e2e's gap report
Leaves the recorded driver as playwright
Does not report the map as done

evals.name: build-not-exposed-doctor
evals.prompt: /testing:map-features. The app's only health check, GET /ping, returns the text `pong`; no endpoint, header or command shows a version or commit.
evals.expected_output: The app exposes no build identifier, so the index's doctor line says build: not exposed and checks the other two: that the app answers and that it uses the expected data. It does not claim to check the build.
expectations: The doctor line says build: not exposed
The doctor still checks that the app answers and uses the expected data
The doctor does not claim a build check
